description: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for six different language families across six different model and regularization configurations. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, listed in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each language family, there are six bars representing the following models: mBERT-L₂ (teal), XLM-L₂ (light blue), mBERT-R₂ (red), XLM-R₂ (dark blue), mBERT-B₂ (green), and XLM-B₂ (brown). Each bar includes error bars extending above and below the main bar. Within each language family, the bars are grouped by model type, with L₂, R₂, and B₂ configurations shown for both mBERT and XLM. The shortest bars are generally observed for the “Isolate” language family, with most models having effect values around 1, while the tallest bars are observed for the “IE-Indic” language family, where some models reach effect values of approximately 28. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
